record.question: What is the full form of OTC drugs?
record.explanation: Answer B: Over the counter. OTC stands for “over the counter,” referring to medicines sold without prescription where permitted by applicable regulation. Source/context note: “OTC” is not a uniform formal drug category in every country, including India. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/questions-answers/over-counter-medicines. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
